title: 第1章 婚内不同房反手炼化玄阴之体第2章 背叛楚家的人都得死
content_zh:
（）;
read2（）;“楚枫，你想干嘛？”
地牢之中，赵雪莲被死死抵在了墙上，娇躯不断扭动。
这原本是她囚禁楚枫的地牢，可就在她即将榨干这个废物最后的纯阳之体时，竟然遭到了反噬。
楚枫抓着赵雪莲的头发，迫使她仰起下巴，露出白皙的脖颈。
“毒妇，你骗我至尊骨，废我灵根，夺我纯阳之体，你真该死啊！”
当初赵雪莲让他必须交出自己最重要的东西，来证明足够爱她。
他不顾父母阻拦，挖出了自己的至尊骨送给了赵雪莲。
没想到赵雪莲竟然是一个蛇蝎毒妇，嫁给他之后便架空楚家，还毁了他。
如今，他成为赤阳丹帝之后重生归来，定要让所有人背叛他的人付出代价。
“你欠我的都要还回来！”
赵雪莲彻底慌了，趁着她体内灵力无法运转，这个废物竟敢对她……
“我们婚前可是有约法三章，你不准碰我，不准逼我，不准爱我！”
玄阴之体是她最大的筹码，否则她还如何转投三皇子的怀抱。
“你的纯阳之体已被我炼化，你难道还想吞噬我的玄阴之体不成？”
楚枫抓着赵雪莲的长发，冷声道。
“你的一切都是我的！”
楚枫运转炼天图，疯狂吞噬着她玄阴之体。
他之所以让赵雪莲遭到反噬，就是因为重生之时，还带回了炼天图。
此图乃是极道帝器，可炼化万物为己用。

啊——
赵雪莲瞳孔一震，下意识惊呼出声。
“楚枫，我答应你，我什么都答应你，不要毁了我的玄阴之体！”
一日一夜。
楚枫丝毫没有怜香惜玉，炼天图与他的身体融合，已经助他觉醒了太初道体。
太初道体可吞噬各种灵体，不断成长，道体的力量越强，他修炼速度也就越快。
彻底炼化了赵雪莲的玄阴之体之后，他的修为也突破到了炼气五重。
楚枫像是扔垃圾一样，将赵雪莲随手扔在了地上。
“你从我这拿走的，我会让你百倍还回来。”
赵雪莲转头恶狠狠地瞪了楚枫一眼，双腿还在微微抽搐。
“你这个畜生！你竟敢毁了我的玄阴之体！
我父亲马上就要从京师回来了，他定会扒你的皮、抽你的筋，让你死无全尸！”
楚枫嗤笑出声，抬脚踩在了她的蜜桃臀上。

read2(); "Chu Feng, what do you want to do?"
In the dungeon, Zhao Xuelian was firmly pressed against the wall, her delicate body twisting continuously.
This was originally the dungeon where she imprisoned Chu Feng, but just when she was about to squeeze out the last pure Yang body of this waste, she suffered a backlash.
Chu Feng grabbed Zhao Xuelian's hair and forced her to raise her chin, exposing her fair neck.
"Vicious woman, you lied to me about my supreme bones, destroyed my spiritual roots, and took away my pure Yang body. You really deserve to die!"
At the beginning, Zhao Xuelian asked him to hand over his most important things to prove that he loved her enough.
Regardless of his parents' obstruction, he dug out his Supreme Bone and gave it to Zhao Xuelian.
Unexpectedly, Zhao Xuelian turned out to be a poisonous woman. After marrying him, she ignored the Chu family and destroyed him.
Now, he has returned after becoming the Chiyang Pill Emperor, and he must make everyone who betrayed him pay the price.
"I'll pay back whatever you owe me!"
Zhao Xuelian was completely panicked. Taking advantage of the fact that the spiritual power in her body was unable to function, this loser dared to attack her...
"We had an agreement before we got married. You are not allowed to touch me, you are not allowed to force me, and you are not allowed to love me!"
The body of Xuanyin was her biggest bargaining chip, otherwise how could she switch to the third prince's arms.
"Your pure Yang body has been refined by me, do you still want to swallow my Xuanyin body?"
Chu Feng grabbed Zhao Xuelian's long hair and said coldly.
"Everything about you is mine!"
Chu Feng circulated the Heaven Refining Diagram and crazily devoured her Xuanyin body.
The reason why he caused Zhao Xuelian to suffer backlash was because he brought back the Heaven Refining Map when he was reborn.
This picture is the ultimate imperial weapon, which can refine all things for one's own use.
Ah——
Zhao Xuelian's pupils trembled, and she subconsciously exclaimed.
"Chu Feng, I promise you, I promise you anything, don't destroy my Xuanyin body!"
One day and one night.
Chu Feng showed no pity for her at all. The Heaven Refining Diagram merged with his body and helped him awaken the Taoist body of Taichu.
The Taoist body of Taichu can swallow all kinds of spiritual bodies and continue to grow. The stronger the power of the Taoist body, the faster he will practice.
After completely refining Zhao Xuelian's Xuanyin body, his cultivation level also broke through to the fifth level of Qi refining.
Chu Feng threw Zhao Xuelian on the ground as if throwing away garbage.
"What you took from me, I will give you back a hundredfold."
Zhao Xuelian turned around and glared at Chu Feng fiercely, her legs still twitching slightly.
"You beast! How dare you destroy my Xuanyin body!
My father is coming back from the capital soon. He will definitely peel off your skin, beat your tendons, and leave you dead without any body parts! "
Chu Feng sneered and raised his foot to step on her peach butt.
